question.:question/problem:
Consider the matrices

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 1 \\ -3 & -1\end{bmatrix},\,B=\begin{bmatrix}-\frac{1}{3} & -\frac{1}{3} \\ 1 & 0\end{bmatrix},\,C=\begin{bmatrix}-1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

I. $AB=BA={I}_{2}$

II. $AC=CA={I}_{2}$

III. $B={A}^{-1}$

Select all that apply. If none apply, leave all boxes unchecked.

$$

\begin{aligned}BA & =\begin{bmatrix}-\frac{1}{3} & -\frac{1}{3} \\ 1 & 0\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}0 & 1 \\ -3 & -1\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\  & ={I}_{2}.\,✓\end{aligned}
